column10: $The Gemini constellation is one — made of my sister and me together.$

column9: $우리는 절대로 떨어질 수 없는 운명을 가진 채 태어났지.$
column10: $We were born with a fate that binds us so tightly we can never be apart.$

column9: $그 누구보다도 가까운 형제라고 할 수 있지.$
column10: $You could say we’re closer than anyone else.$

column9: $얼마든지! 서로에 대해 알아가는 것 만큼 좋은 게 없지.$
column10: $Of course! There’s nothing better than getting to know each other.$

$Ah, you’re interested in stardust too?$

column9: $아쉽지만, 별자리가 아니라면 별가루에 아무런 효과가 없을 거야.$

$Ribby! Do you have something you want to say?$

column9: $밖으로 나오는 것 자체를 별로 좋아하지 않았어.$
column10: $She never really liked going out much to begin with.$

column9: $혼자서 사색에 잠기거나, 명상을 하거나. 혼자 조용히 지내는 시간이 많았지.$

column9: $문제는, 그런 성향을 가진 사람들은 대체로 우울한 기분도 오래 간다는 거야.$
column10: $The problem is, people with that kind of nature tend to stay sad for a long time too.$

column9: $이전에 말한 적이 있듯이… 우리의 관계는 복잡해.$
column10: $As I mentioned before… our relationship is complicated.$

column9: $동생의 기분은 곧 나의 기분이 되기도 해.$
column10: $Her emotions often become my emotions as well.$

column9: $…나는 동생이 그렇게 오래 슬퍼하는 걸 두고 볼 수 없었어.$
column10: $…I couldn’t just sit and watch her be sad for so long.$
$So I simply talked to her every day.$
$How her day was, what she planned for tomorrow.$

column9: $도중에는 마음이 급해 져서, 동생을 밖으로 끌어내기 위한 말들을 했지.$
column10: $At times, I got impatient and said things to push her to come outside.$

column9: $사람들이 널 기다리고 있다고, 언제까지 그렇고만 있을 수는 없다고…$
column10: $I told her that people were waiting for her, that she couldn’t stay like that forever…$

column9: $어쩌면, 조용히 기다려 주는 게 맞았던 걸지도 모르겠네.$
column10: $Maybe… waiting quietly would’ve been the right thing to do.$

column9: $하지만 한편으로는… 꾹 참고 혼자만의 시간을 주는 걸…$
column10: $But on the other hand… could I have really been patient enough to just give her time alone forever?$

column9: $나는 언제까지고 인내심 있게 할 수 있었을까, 하는 생각이 들기도 해.$
column10: $Sometimes I wonder.$

$Ribby! Do you have something you want to say?$
$Ribby! Do you have something you want to say?$
$How to express feelings…?$

column9: $단순히 동생과 대화를 나누는 것 이외의 특별한 방법을 찾아야 하는 걸까.$
column10: $Maybe I need to find a special way to express myself to my sister, beyond just talking.$

column9: $이건… 한번도 생각해 본 적이 없는 걸.$
column10: $Hmm… that’s something I’ve never thought about before.$

$Hmm…$

column9: $뭐, 여러가지 시도도 해 보고, 노랙해 봐야 겠지.$
column10: $Well, I guess I’ll have to try different things and see what works.$
$Thanks for the advice, Ribby.$
$Um… hello.$
$I’m Pollo, from the Gemini constellation.$

$Um, s-sorry.$

column9: $무슨 말을 해야 할 지… 잘 모르겠어서…$
column10: $I don’t really know what to say…$

$I can take my brother’s ‘place’ anytime I want.$

column9: $형은... 자신의 자리가 뺏겼다는 것조차 눈치채지 못하지.$
column10: $He… doesn’t even realize when his place has been taken.$
$That’s what’s happening right now.$

column9: $…내가 말해주지 않으면, 형은 영원히 모를 거야.$
column10: $…If I don’t tell him, he’ll never know.$
$Never…$
$Could it be… my brother too…?$
$I also have… a friend no one else knows about.$

column9: $어쩌다 만나게 되었는데… 말이 잘 통하는 것 같았어.$
column10: $We met by chance… but we seemed to get along really well.$

column9: $철학적인 이야기도 좋아하고, 내가 뜬금없는 이야기를 해도 잘 받아 줬어.$
column10: $They like deep, philosophical conversations, and even when I said random things, they always listened kindly.$

column9: $리비 너도… 이야기를 잘 들어주는 것 같아.$

column10: $I was on a journey to make the universe shine again!$

column9: $이야기는 얼추 전해 들었다. 우리가 별가루를 모으는 것을 도와주겠다고 했지?$

column9: $별자리들에게 필요한 것들은 조금씩 달라질 수 있으니까…$

column9: $무엇을 해야 할 지 혹시나 잊어버리게 된다면 나침반을 잘 활용해 보라고.$

column9: $나에게 별가루를 많이 가져다 줄 수록, 내가 가진 별자리의 힘도 점점 강해지지.$

column9: $그렇게 되면 이 곳에서 할 수 있는 일들도 점점 더 많아질거야.$
column10: $And when that happens, the things I can do here will gradually increase as well.$

column9: $아아, 별가루… 나의 빛, 나의 삶, 나의 기쁨…$
column10: $Ahh, stardust… my light, my life, my joy…$

$Of course!$

column9: $개인마다 정도의 차이는 있겠지만. 어쨌거나 반드시 필요한 거라고.$
column10: $Though the degree may differ for each of us, it’s something absolutely essential.$

column10: $Phew, I think I’ve received quite enough.$

column9: $언제든 돌아오는 것도 가능하니 나랑 헤어지는 일에 너무 아쉬워 말라고!$

column9: $오오, 여전히 나에게 신경 써 주는 건가!$

column9: $정말 고마운 걸! 어떻게 보답을 해야 할 지 모르겠어.$
column10: $Thank you so much! I don’t even know how to repay you.$

column9: $뭔가를 도와주고 싶어도, 넌 하나부터 열까지 척척 잘 하니까 말야!$
column10: $Even if I wanted to help, you handle everything so perfectly from start to finish!$

column9: $꽤나 적응한 모양인데, 어때. 일은 잘 되어 가나?$
column10: $It seems you’ve adapted quite well. So, how’s it going? Is the work going smoothly?$

column9: $언제든 심심하면 나랑 떠들면서 시간 보내도 괜찮아.$
column10: $If you’re ever bored, you’re welcome to spend time chatting with me.$

column9: $너가 지금 우리에게 해 주는 것처럼 말야.$

column9: $그런 멋진 녀석들은, 한 곳에 오래 머무르기보다는 이곳저곳 여행하기를 좋아하니까.$
column10: $Such remarkable folks preferred to travel from place to place, rather than staying in one spot.$

column9: $뭐, 이제 나에게는 충분한 양의 별가루가 모인 것 같군!$

column9: $아직 도움이 필요한 녀석들이 있을 테니, 다른 곳으로 가 보는게 어떻겠나?$
column10: $There must be others still in need, so why don’t you visit them?$

column9: $그동안 정말 수고 많았다고, 나의 친구 리비. 이 은혜는 잊지 못할 거야!$
column10: $You’ve really worked hard all this time, my friend Ribby. I’ll never forget this kindness!$
$Hello, Ribby.$

column9: $앗, 안녕하세요, 별자리 님! 다시 뵙게 되었네요!$
column10: $Ah, hello, Constellation! We meet again!$

column9: $금방 다시 만났네. 그동안 별 일 없었니?$
column10: $We met again so soon. Nothing much happened in the meantime?$

column9: $크리소 님을 만났어요! 잘 지내고 있다고, 안부 전해 달라고 하셨어요.$
column10: $I met Chryso! He asked me to tell you he’s doing well.$
$So you were already helping us… I’m so grateful.$

column9: $아, 참. 그렇지. 이전에 만났을 땐 정말 정신이 없었지?$
column10: $Ah, right. That’s true. When we first met, things were really hectic, weren’t they?$

column9: $정식으로 소개할게. 나의 이름은 이오, 황소 별자리 이오라고 해.$
column10: $Let me introduce myself properly. My name is Io, the Taurus Constellation.$
$It’s nice to meet you, Io, after such a long time!$

column9: $응, 혹시나 궁금한 게 있다면 나를 찾아와 줘.$
column10: $Yes, if you ever feel curious about something, come to me.$
$I always welcome a comfortable chat.$
$Thank you.$

column9: $이렇게나 우리를 도와주는 건 몇 번이나 감사를 해도 모자라겠는걸.$
column10: $No matter how many times I thank you, it won’t be enough for helping us this much.$

column9: $너무 무리하는 건 아니길 바랄게. 혹시라도… 걱정이 되어서 그래.$
column10: $I just hope you’re not overdoing it. I only worry about that, you see.$

column9: $걱정 마세요! 쉬는 것도, 일하는 것도, 필요한 만큼 하고 있으니까요!$
column10: $Don’t worry! I’m resting and working only as much as I need!$

column9: $정말 대견한걸… 그 작은 몸으로 어떻게 이런 일들을 하는 건지.$
column10: $Truly admirable… how you can manage all this with such a small body.$
$Then, I’ll ask this of you.$
$…I really like stardust.$

column9: $다른 친구들은 별꿀, 별꽃… 심지어는 젤리를 만들어 먹는 녀석도 있어.$
column10: $Other friends like Starhoney, Starflowers… there’s even one who makes jelly.$

$Pios once made cake out of stardust.$
$Stardust cake…! I’d love to try that too!$

column9: $이름만 들어도 반짝반짝 달콤한 맛이 날 것 같은데요!$
column10: $Just the name alone sounds sparkly and sweet!$
$Uh…$
$Um, well. You see.$
$How should I explain this?$
$You see, stardust isn’t something you eat.$

column9: $별가루는 먹는 게 아니라구요? 그러면 케이크랑 젤리랑 그거는 다…$
column10: $Stardust isn’t something to eat? Then what about the cake and jelly and all that…$
$It’s really difficult to explain… hmm.$

column9: $아무튼! 별가루는 먹는 게 아니야! 그것만은 알아 둬.$
column10: $Anyway! Stardust isn’t for eating! Just keep that in mind.$
$I’ll explain more clearly… when the time comes.$

column9: $이오 님, 제가 곰곰히 생각을 해 보았는데요.$
column10: $Io, I’ve been thinking about something.$
$…Hm? About what?$

column9: $별가루가 먹는 게 아니라면, 별자리 님들은 별가루를 어디에 쓰시는 거에요?$
column10: $If stardust isn’t for eating, then what do you constellations use it for?$
$Well…$

column9: $별가루는… 우리의 근원이자, 구성 물질… 뭐 그런…$
column10: $Stardust is… our origin, our essence… something like that…$
$No. Stardust is for eating.$

column9: $맛있게 먹는 거야. 숨겨서 아껴 뒀다가 남 몰래 꺼내 먹어.$
column10: $We eat it deliciously. We hide it away and secretly take it out to eat later.$
$I’ve made up my mind.$
$Uh, huh? What decision?$

column9: $별자리 님들이 별가루를 어디에 쓰는 건지 궁금해졌어요.$
column10: $I’ve become curious about what you constellations truly use stardust for.$

column9: $이오 님이 제대로 대답해주시기 전까지 전 아무것도 하지 않을 거에요.$
column10: $Until you give me a proper answer, I won’t do anything.$
$You won’t do anything… what do you mean…$

column9: $별가루를 만들고 배달하는 것도 안 할 거에요.$
column10: $I won’t make or deliver stardust either.$
$…Gasp.$
$Alright, I understand. I give up. I’ll tell you.$
$Yay!$

column9: $대신, 별가루 조금만 가져다 줄래? 그러면 알려 줄게.$
column10: $But in return, could you bring me just a little stardust? Then I’ll tell you.$
$Really? You promise?$

column9: $물론이야. 우주의 신들은 약속을 어기는 법이 없지.$
column10: $Of course. Gods of the universe never break their promises.$

column9: $이오 님! 약속대로 별가루를 가져 왔어요! 이제 별가루의 비밀에 대해 알려주시는 건가요?$
column10: $Io! I brought the stardust as promised! Now will you tell me the secret of stardust?$
$Persistent, aren’t you, our Ribby.$

column9: $저의 성실함과 끈기는 크리소 님도 인정해 주셨지요.$
column10: $Even Chryso acknowledged my diligence and persistence.$
$Then now… it’s time for the truth!$
$Haa…$
$Alright, a promise is a promise.$
$Stardust, you see… it isn’t food.$
$Stardust is actually…!$
$(…gulp)$
$…When you eat it, it makes you feel good.$
$…That’s it?$
$Yes. That’s all.$
$You’re teasing me, aren’t you!$

column9: $전애도 말했지만, 우주의 신들은 약속을 어기는 일이 없어.$
column10: $As I said before, gods of the universe never break their promises.$
$I only told you the truth.$

column9: $아까는 대단한 비밀이 있는 것 처럼 숨기려고 하셨잖아요! 왜 그러신건가요?$
column10: $Earlier you acted like it was some grand secret you had to hide! Why did you do that?$
$But…$
$Seeing you react so amusingly like this…$
$Sorry, Ribby.$
$Ha, haha…$
$…Ribby, are you mad?$

column9: $아아뇨. 화가 나진 않았어요. 조금 허무하긴 했는데!$
column10: $No, not mad. Just a little disappointed!$

column9: $나 같은 사람들은 다른 사람이랑 장난 칠 기회가 많이 없거든… $
column10: $People like me don’t get many chances to play pranks on others…$
$Thank you for playing along. Hehe.$
$I’ll be counting on you from now on too.$

column9: $정말 굉장한 걸. 나의 힘이 거의 돌아온 것 같아.$
column10: $Truly amazing. I feel like most of my strength has already returned.$
$At an incredible pace, Ribby.$

column9: $그런가요…? 저는 제가 너무 느린 건 아닐까 생각하고 있었어요.$
column10: $Really…? I was thinking maybe I’m too slow.$

column9: $크리소 님에게 별가루를 모아드리는 일은 지금보다 훨씬 빨리 끝났거든요.$
column10: $When I gathered stardust for Chryso, it ended much faster.$

column9: $크리소는 바보라서 그래. 바보는 감기에도 안 걸린다고 하잖아?$
column10: $That’s because Chryso’s a fool. You know what they say, fools don’t even catch colds?$
$Overflowing with foolish energy, his recovery is unbelievably fast.$

column9: $그 녀석은 별가루를 안 주고 1년 동안 방치해도 소리를 지르면서 뛰어다닐거야.$
column10: $Even if you left him without stardust for a year, he’d still be running around shouting.$
$Indeed… yes, that really does sound like him…$
$You’ve worked so hard, Ribby!$

column9: $나는 이제 혼자서도 끄떡 없어. 다른 친구들을 도와 주면 좋겠어.$
column10: $Now I can manage on my own. I’d like you to help the others.$
$I really enjoyed being with you, Io!$

column9: $그렇게 영원히 이별하는 사람처럼 말하지는 말고… 하하..$
column10: $Don’t speak as if we’re parting forever… haha…$
$I can always come back anytime.$

column9: $그래. 언제든 또 돌아올 수 있으니까, 그렇지?$
column10: $Yes. You can always come back anytime, right?$
$Let’s meet again.$
$See you again soon!$
$You’ve returned, Ribby. How are things going?$
$And once again, you’ve brought me stardust.$
$As kind as ever. Make yourself at home.$
$Stardust is truly fascinating.$

column9: $꿀이 되든, 사탕이 되든, 쿠키가 되든… 그 본질을 잃지 않아.$
column10: $Whether it turns into honey, candy, or cookies… it never loses its essence.$

column9: $이상하지 않아? 우리 별자리들마저도 정확한 정체를 몰라.$
column10: $Isn’t that strange? Even we constellations don’t know exactly what it really is.$

column9: $별자리와 별들을 구성하는 가장 기본적이고 근본적인 단위라는 것 이외에는…$
column10: $All we know is that it’s the most basic and fundamental unit that makes up constellations and stars…$

column9: $그런 걸로 고작 케이크나 만들어 먹는다는 건 어딘가 우스운 일이야.$
column10: $And yet, using something like that just to bake a cake feels a little ridiculous.$
$Lately, things around here have gotten much noisier.$

column9: $별자리들이 하나 둘씩 잠에서 깨어나고, 별들이 빛나기 시작하고…$
column10: $Constellations are waking up one by one, and the stars are beginning to shine…$

column9: $물론, 정말 멋진 일이야. 다 리비 네 덕분이지.$
column10: $Of course, it’s a truly wonderful thing. And it’s all thanks to you, Ribby.$

column9: $그렇지만 가끔은... 빛 사그라들어 버린 그 날 이후의 정적이 그립기도 해.$
column10: $But sometimes… I find myself missing the stillness that followed the day the light went out.$

column9: $다른 별자리들과 다르게, 난 그런 걸 무서워 하지 않았거든.$
column10: $Unlike the other constellations, I was never afraid of that silence.$
$…I’ve been thinking about it a little.$

column9: $그래도 역시, 시끌벅적한 게 좋은 것 같아.$
column10: $And still, I think I like the lively atmosphere better.$

column9: $나는 조용하고, 아무도 없는 곳에서 혼자만의 시간을 보내길 좋아해.$
column10: $I enjoy spending time alone, in a quiet place where no one else is around.$

column9: $그러한 성향이 나보다 더욱 강한 사람들도 있겠지.$
column10: $And I’m sure there are people out there who feel that way even more strongly than I do.$

column9: $하지만, 그 사람들도 반드시 한번은 바깥의 소리를 들으러 나갈 필요가 있어.$
column10: $But even they need to step outside and listen to the sounds of the world at least once.$
$Chryso was always a nuisance by my side…$

column9: $내 곁에 아무도 없어 누군가가 필요했을 때,$
column10: $But when there was no one around and I needed someone,$

column9: $옆에서 귀찮게 굴어 준 것도 그 녀석이었으니까.$
column10: $he was the one who stayed beside me and annoyed me then too.$
$…I’m grateful for that.$
$Phew…$

column9: $우리가 처음 만나게 된 지도 꽤 되었구나.$
column10: $It’s been quite some time since we first met.$
$You’ll be coming back soon, right?$
$Of course, Io. We’re friends now, aren’t we?$
$Ahaha, that’s right.$

column9: $심심할 때도, 갑자기 생각이 날 때도, 언제든 찾아와. 친구.$
column10: $Whenever you’re bored or suddenly think of me, you’re always welcome to visit, my friend.$
$Hello, you must be Ribby?$
$Nice to meet you! My name is Kastro.$

column9: $저도 만나서 기뻐요, 제 이름을 알고 계시는군요!$
column10: $Nice to meet you too! You already know my name!$

column9: $그럼, 넌 이미 유명인사야! 별가루를 모아 별자리들을 도와주고 있다고 들었어.$
column10: $Of course, you’re already famous! I heard you’ve been collecting stardust to help the constellations.$
$That’s amazing, it’s not an easy thing to do.$
$Oh~ it’s nothing really. It’s actually quite fun!$

column9: $조금만 기다려 주세요, 카스트로. 금방 별자리들을 만들어 올게요!$
column10: $Please wait a moment, Kastro. I’ll go make the constellations right away!$

column9: $아아, 정말 고마워!! 폴로도 분명 기뻐할 거야...$
column10: $Ahh, thank you so much!! Pollo will surely be happy too...$

column9: $내가 무엇을 도와줄 수 있을 지는 잘 모르겠지만…$
column10: $I’m not sure what I can do to help, but...$

column9: $나는 널 항상 응원하고 있을 테니, 그럼 파이팅이야!$
column10: $I’ll always be cheering for you. So, keep it up!$
$Wow! Stardust— it’s been so long since I last saw it.$
$Thank you again, Ribby!$
$I can make as much as you need!$
$Haha! You’re truly amazing.$

column9: $네가 만들어 준 이 별가루들, 정말로 풍부한 향이야.$
column10: $This stardust you made has such a rich fragrance.$
$Stardust brewed from star nectar… it has something truly special.$

column9: $별꿀도, 별꽃도, 어떠한 형태로든 전부 별가루라고 불리는군요?$
column10: $Star nectar, star flowers… and they’re all called stardust in their own way?$

column9: $맞아! 어떤 모습으로 만들어져도, 본질은 변하지 않거든.$
column10: $That’s right! No matter what form it takes, its essence never changes.$

column9: $우리의 정신과 영혼을 하나의 세계로 인도하는 것.$
column10: $It guides our spirit and soul toward one world.$
$A great explosion that occurred long ago, on the other side…$
$We were all born from within it… from stardust itself.$
$That’s such… a profound story…$
$Thank you again for the stardust!$
$My little sister will surely be happy too.$
$Your sister…?$

column9: $응. 쌍둥이 별자리는 나와 동생이, 둘이서 하나인 별자리야.$
column10: $Yeah. The Gemini constellation— it’s my sister and me, two as one.$
$When I fall asleep, my sister comes out.$

column9: $동생이 잠에 들면, 다시 내가 밖으로 나오지.$
column10: $When she falls asleep, I come out again.$
$So, you take turns keeping watch!$

column9: $하지만, 그렇게 되면 두 사람은 서로를 영원히 볼 수 없는 것 아닌가요…?$
column10: $But… if that’s the case, doesn’t it mean you two can never see each other…?$
$That sounds a little sad…$
$Not exactly.$

column9: $네 말대로 우리는 서로의 얼굴을 볼 수 없지만… 언제나 함께 있는 셈이거든.$
column10: $As you said, we can’t see each other’s faces… but we’re always together in a way.$

column9: $리비. 널 보면, 동생의 옛날 모습이 떠올라.$
column10: $Ribby, when I see you, I’m reminded of my sister’s younger days.$

column9: $그 녀석도 너처럼 밝고 활기찬 때가 있었는데…$
column10: $She used to be bright and full of energy, just like you...$
$Did something happen to your sister…?$

column9: $사실… 폴로는 밖으로 나온 지 조금 됐어.$
column10: $Actually… Pollo hasn’t come out for a while now.$

column9: $도통 밖으로 나오려 하질 않아서, 여때까지 내가 쭉 바깥에 있었지.$
column10: $She just doesn’t seem to want to, so I’ve been outside all this time.$

column9: $속상한 일이 있었던 것 같기는 한데… 자세히는 알 수가 없으니…$
column10: $I think something happened that made her sad… but I’m not sure what.$
$I see…$
$Kastro, I have a question.$

column9: $응! 말해 봐. 너가 궁금한 거라면, 뭐든지 대답해 줄게.$
column10: $Sure! Go ahead. I’ll answer anything you’re curious about.$

column9: $동생이 밖으로 나오지 않게 된 건… 얼마 전에 있었던 일이에요?$
column10: $Has it been long since your sister stopped coming out?$
$Hmm… let’s see? Not that long, I suppose.$
$Then…$
$Maybe…$
$…about 400 years?$
$…Excuse me?$

column9: $아, 석상으로 잠들어 있었던 기간을 빼면 더 길어져. 잠시만 기다려 봐…$
column10: $Ah, if you don’t count the time I spent sleeping as a statue, it’d be even longer. Wait a sec…$
$No… no, that’s quite enough.$
$Four hundred years… four hundred… haha…$
$Kastro, I have something to say.$
$Uh, yeah. You look really serious.$
$That’s right, it’s something serious.$

column9: $동생이 밖으로 나오지 않게 된 400년 이라는 시간은 말이죠… $
column10: $That 400 years since your sister stopped coming out…$

column9: $엄청나게 오랜 세월을 살아 온 신들에겐 찰나의 순간일 수 있지만…$
column10: $To the gods who have lived for ages, it might seem like just a fleeting moment…$

column9: $사이가 멀어진 두 명의 사람이 화해하기에는 끔찍하게 긴 시간일 수도 있다구요.$
column10: $But for two people who’ve grown apart, it could be an unbearably long time to make amends.$
$Ah… I guess you’re right…$
$Don’t you think the other constellations also want to see your sister?$

column9: $…맞아. 크리소도, 이오도, 동생이 밖으로 나오지를 않으니 잔뜩 걱정하고 있어.$
column10: $…Yeah. Chrysos and Io have both been worried since she stopped coming out.$
$I should keep trying to talk to her.$
$Thank you, Ribby.$
$You’re very welcome.$
$…Star Ice.$
$It’s my sister’s favorite kind of stardust.$

column9: $우리는 둘이서 하나지만… 성격도, 취향도, 참 달랐지.$
column10: $Though we’re one, our personalities and tastes were always so different.$
$Ribby, do you have any brothers or sisters?$
$No, I don’t. But I do have friends.$

column9: $그거 좋은데. 네 친구들도 다들 너처럼 멋진 친구들이겠지.$
column10: $That’s nice. I bet your friends are as wonderful as you are.$
$Brothers and sisters… they’re like very close friends.$
$You spend countless years together, side by side…$

column9: $결국 나와는 다른, 이해와 배려가 필요한 타인이야.$
column10: $But in the end, they’re still someone different from you — someone who needs understanding and care.$
$Maybe… I had forgotten that.$
$(What a thoughtful person...)$
$Ribby, thank you for bringing the stardust again today.$
$Today, I even made some cookies.$

column9: $이오 님이 살짝 말씀하신 건데… 정말로 별가루로 쿠키를 만들 수 있을 줄은 몰랐어요.$
column10: $Lord Io mentioned it briefly, but… I didn’t think you could actually make cookies with stardust!$

column9: $별가루로 만들지 못하는 것은 없지. 케이크를 만들어 먹는 녀석도 있다고.$
column10: $There’s nothing that can’t be made from stardust. Some even bake cakes with it.$

column9: $별가루로 케이크를 만드는 것은 엄청난 도전이 될 것 같네요…!$
column10: $Making a cake out of stardust sounds like quite the challenge…!$

column9: $어, 그게… 부담을 주려던 건 아니었는데. 어쩐지 미안하네, 하하.$
column10: $Oh, I didn’t mean to pressure you. Sorry if I did, haha.$
$Oh right, that reminds me, Ribby…$
$I’m planning to talk to my sister soon.$
$…You haven’t said anything to her yet?!$

column9: $저기, 나도 마음의 준비를 할 시간이 필요하다고.$
column10: $Hey, I just needed some time to prepare myself.$

column9: $어째서 그 상태로 400년이란 시간이 흘렸는 지 알 것 같기도 하네요…$
column10: $Now I think I understand how that 400 years went by so easily…$

column9: $슬슬 때가 되었구나. 힘이 충분히 돌아온 것 같아.$
column10: $It’s about time. I can feel my strength returning.$
$You’ve done great, Kastro!$
$Hahaha! You’re the one who did all the hard work, Ribby.$
$Next is… the Cancer constellation, right?$
$Yes, they’re full of energy, so it’ll definitely be fun.$
$I hope things work out between you and your sister. Really!$
$Thanks. I’ll make sure to talk to her.$

column9: $정말 수고 많았어. 다음에 또 보자, 리비.$
column10: $You’ve done an amazing job. See you again soon, Ribby.$
$…Hmm?$
$Hello? Are you not here, Lord Kastro?$
$…Ribby.$
$Y-yes? Who are you?!$
$Ribby, right…? I thought so…$
$I’ve been watching everything.$
$May I… ask your name?$
$…Pollo.$
$I’m… Kastro’s younger sister.$
$Ah, I knew it! I was right. It’s nice to meet you, Pollo!$
$…Yeah.$

column9: $내가 형의 '자리'를 뺏었어… 그래서 내가 밖으로 나온 거야.$
column10: $I took my brother’s ‘place’… That’s why I’m the one outside now.$
$I see…!$
$…You’re Lord Kastro’s sister… right?$
$Yeah.$
$I see…$
$Um… I’ll keep going. Making stardust, I mean.$
$…Okay.$
$Here, this is the stardust.$
$…Thanks.$
$…Can you tell me what happened?$
$Between you and Kastro.$
$Yeah, well. Kastro is… Kastro’s an idiot.$

column9: $매일… 매일 물어봐… 오늘 하루는 어땠는지, 앞으로는 어떻게 할 건지…$
column10: $Every day… he’d ask… how my day was, what I planned to do next…$
$He kept asking until I got so tired I drifted away…$

column9: $그러면 그럴 수록… 밖으로 나가는 게 힘들어져.$
column10: $And the more he did, the harder it became for me to go outside.$
$…He probably never realized.$
$Hmm…$
$I got angry.$
$And yet… he still came to me saying he was doing it for my sake…$
$I see…$
$Hmm…$
$…It’s been a long time since I came outside.$
$Four hundred years… was it?$
$Um… excuse me,$
$Thank you for making the stardust.$
$Hehe, you’re very welcome.$
$This is… star ice.$
$It’s your favorite kind of stardust, isn’t it, Lady Pollo?$

column9: $폴로 님은 별얼음을 제일 좋아한다고, 카스트로 님이 말씀하셨지요.$
column10: $Lord Kastro told me you love star ice the most.$
$I don’t remember ever telling him that…$

column9: $글쎄요… 그만큼 폴로 님을 잘 알고 있었나 봐요.$
column10: $Well… I guess he knew you that well.$
$Pollo, I’ve been thinking a little.$
$Oh? Hmm?$

column9: $카스트로 님이 폴로 님을 힘들게 했을 수도 있지만…$
column10: $Lord Kastro may have made things hard for you…$
